question: The Mattancherry palace is situated in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Mattancherry palace is situated in **Kerala**.
 
• **The Mattancherry Palace,** commonly known as the Dutch Palace, is an **examples of Kerala architecture** with colonial influences.
 
• It was established about **1545 C.E. by the Portuguese as a gift to King Veera Kerala Verma** of the Kochi dynasty and is located around 12 kilometres from Ernakulam.
 
• As a result of the Dutch's extensive repairs, it became known as the Dutch Palace.
 
• **Pazhayannur Bhagavathy, the royal family's deity, **lives there as well (the Deity of Pazhayannur).
 
• These feature famous Indian epics such as the Ramayana and Mahabharata, as well as Hindu Gods such as Lord Krishna of Guruvayur Temple.
 
• The great Sanskrit poet Kalidasa's works have also been translated.
